entities.name: WLAN offload indication
entities.description: Indicates if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s).

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that includes or excludes the WLAN offload indication IE based on network policies.

entities.name: Deactivate all EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Condition where MME wishes to deactivate all EPS bearer contexts of a PDN connection.

relations.description: MME includes the WLAN offload indication IE in the message when indicating WLAN offload permission.
If MME wishes to deactivate all EPS bearer contexts, it shall not include the WLAN offload indication IE.
